welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: Andao ho vonona amin'ny fitsidihanao ianao.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Valio ny fanontaniana vitsivitsy momba ny soritr'aretinao.

btnStart.translation: Atombohy ny fisoratana anarana mialoha ny fitsidihana

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Mampifandray ny fitsidihanao amin'ny rakitsoratrao izany.

interviewLoadError.translation: Tsy afaka nampiditra ny dinidinika nataonao izahay.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Misaotra Hanao fanontaniana haingana vitsivitsy momba izay nahatonga anao ho ao aho.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Soraty ny valiny, na tsindrio ny soso-kevitra etsy ambony

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Tsindrio ny zavatra rehetra mba hanamboarana azy alohan'ny handefasana azy.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Toa tsara mandefa any amin'ny dokotera

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Raha mavesatra ny soritr'aretinao na miharatsy kokoa amin'izao fotoana izao, aza miandry antsoy ny sampana vonjy taitra.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Mangataha fikarakarana ao anatin'ny 12 ora azafady

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Ny soritr'aretinao dia milaza zavatra tokony ho hita tsy ho ela.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Mahazo avy hatrany ny tantaram-piainanao ny ekipa mpitsabo.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Raha miharatsy kokoa izany, manaova zavatra haingana

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Miharatsy mafy na tampoka antsoy avy hatrany ny serivisy vonjy taitra.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Fanamarihana mandeha ho azy momba ny vonjy taitra io, fa tsy famaritana.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Efa hita tao amin'ity hopitaly ity ianao taloha.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Efa mitazona ny firaketanao izy ireo, ka hitan'ny ekipan'ny fikarakaranao avy hatrany ny tantaranao feno.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Tsy nahafantatra ny toerana misy anao izahay.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Ao amin'ny ekipan'ny fikarakarana ny fampahafantarana anao, ary hampandre anao izahay raha vantany vao misy mpitsabo manokatra azy.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Raha vao mainka miharatsy ny toe-javatra, manaova zavatra izao.

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Aza miandry ny toeran'ny filaharanao. Raha mafy na miharatsy tampoka ny soritr'aretinao antsoy izao ny sampana vonjy taitra na mankanesa any amin'ny sampana vonjy taitra akaiky indrindra.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Nampahafantarinay ho laharam-pahamehana kokoa ny raharahanareo mba hahafantaran'ny ekipan'ny fikarakarana.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Mandinika ny antsipiriany ny mpitsabo iray, hampahafantatra anao izahay rehefa mandroso izany.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Valio ny fanontaniana vitsivitsy momba ny fahasalamanao hatramin'ny fitsidihanao.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Inona no mampitaha ny fahasalamanao amin'ny teo aloha?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Misy zavatra hafa tianao holazaina amintsika ve?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Faly izahay fa mihatsara ny fahasalamanao.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Nalefa tany amin'ny ekipan'ny fikarakarana ny valinteninao.

checkinResultEscalate.translation: Miangavy anao mba hitady fikarakarana avy hatrany

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Ny soritr'aretinao dia manondro zavatra iray mila fikarakarana haingana. Aza miandry mifandraisa amin'ny ekipan'ny fikarakarana anao na mankanesa any amin'ny sampana vonjy maika akaiky indrindra.

checkinExpired.translation: Tapitra ity rohy fisoratana anarana ity

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Tsy misy intsony ity fanaraha-maso ity. Midira mba hahitana ny fisoratana anarana amin'izao fotoana izao.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Voamarina ny fisoratana anarana, mamorona kaonty maimaim-poana hanarahana ity fitsidihana ity ary afaho ny kaody amin'ny manaraka.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Alefantsika fehezan-dalàna tokana tsy misy tenimiafina tadidintsika.

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Ampidiro ny findainao na ny mailakao ary handefa kaody fidirana izahay.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Mifandray amin'ny rakitsoratry ny hopitaly ny kaontinao

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Fahadisoana amin'ny tambajotram-pifandraisana, jereo ny fifandraisana ary andramo indray.

errResendFailed.translation: Tsy afaka nandefa indray aho, andramo indray.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Ho an'ny fiarovana anao sy ny fiarovana ny angon-drakitra momba ny marary, efa nisoratra anarana ianao taorian'ny fotoana tsy niasana.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Atombohy ny fisoratana anarana mba hanombohana fitsidihana vaovao.

dashNoPastVisits.translation: Mbola tsy nisy fitsidihana teo aloha.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Miantso antso momba ny fikarakarana amin'ity fampiharana ity · tsy zaraina velively ny nomeraon-telefaoninao.

dashSimulateCall.translation: Ataovy tahaka ny antso ho an'ny fikarakarana tonga · demo

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Safidio hoe iza no miantso anao, ary ahoana no fihetseham-pony.

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Tsia, marina, tsy misy resaka kely

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Salama Jordan, tonga ny fotoan'ny fatra hariva...

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Tsy misy antso amin'ny 9:30 PM 7:30 AM · miverina amin'ny fampandrenesana

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Mijanona ho mavitrika ny tsipika fikarakarana anao misoratra anarana indray mba hitantanana antso sy fampahatsiahivana.

callRingVerified.translation: Voamarina · amin'ny alàlan'ny tsipika fikarakarana anao {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Fiantsoana amin'ny feo voahidy · WebRTC · tsy zaraina velively ny nomeraon-telefaoninao

callSummaryReported.translation: Natao tatitra tamin'ny ekipan'ny mpitsabo anao

callSummarySnoozed.translation: FANTATRA 1 ora rehefa avy nandriaka ny oram-panala

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Ianao sy ny {hospital} ihany no afaka mahita an'ireo. Tsindrio ny fitsidihana mba hamakiana ny famintinana nizara taminao.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Mbola tsy misy fikarakarana ilaina amin'ity fitsidihana ity.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Ity dia famintinana nizara taminao fa tsy aretina. Raha miverina na miharatsy ny soritr'aretinao dia mitadiava fikarakarana vonjy maika avy hatrany.

visitDetailNotFound.translation: Tsy nahita an'io fitsidihana io izahay.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Mety ho nesorina io fitsidihana io, na tsy misy dikany intsony ilay rohy.

visitDetailBackToVisits.translation: Hiverina any amin'ny fitsidihana teo aloha

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Manova ny fiteny isaky ny efijery avy hatrany.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Tsy afaka mandika - misafidy sy mandika an-tanana

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Ny anaranao, ny mombamomba anao, ary ny valin-teninao maimaim-poana dia esorina alohan'ny hialan'ny zavatra rehetra ao amin'ny hopitaly. Ny ekipan'ny fikarakarana ihany no mahita ny antsipiriany mamantatra; ny fikarohana sy ny famakafakana dia mahita ny angon-drakitra tsy mamantatra fotsiny.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Avelao ny angon-drakitra tsy fantatra mba hanatsarana ny fikarakarana ho an'ny rehetra. Afaka manova izany ianao amin'ny fotoana rehetra.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Azonao atao ny manova izany amin'ny fotoana rehetra.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Esory tsy tapaka ny kaontinao sy ny antsipirian'ny fifandraisana.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Angataho ny famintinana ny fitsidihanao, ny fanafodyo, ary ny tantaram-pitiavanao.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Io dia manala ny kaontinao sy ny antsipirian'ny fifandraisanao, ary mitazona ny tantaram-pitandremanao araka ny takian'ny lalàna ny hopitaly.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Hanamafy amin'ny alalan'ny mailaka ao anatin'ny 72 ora ny ekipan'ny fikarakarana anao.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Misafidiana endrika ary mangataka ny fanondrananao. Hanomana izany izahay ary handefa rohy azo antoka amin'ny mailaka voasoratra anarana.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Handefa mailaka rohy azo antoka mankany amin'ny adiresy voasoratra anarana ao anatin'ny 24 ora izahay.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Tsy misy rakitra alaina eto - alefa soa aman-tsara any amin'ny mailakao voasoratra anarana ny firaketanao.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact
callSummaryDeclinedLogged.translation: Nolavina ny antso? Voarakitra ho tsy misy fifandraisana

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact
callSummaryEndedLogged.translation: Tapitra ny antso? voarakitra ho tsy misy fifandraisana

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Ampidiro ny rohy fanasana nalefan'ny hopitaly anao, na tadiavo ny kaody QR.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Tsy toa rohy na kaody fanasana Triavi izany.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteEnterManually.translation: Ampidiro amin'ny tanana ny rohy fanasana

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Mitondra anao mivantana any amin'ny antsipiriany ny fehezan-dalàna ara-pitsaboana manan-kery.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Ny fehezan-dalàna ara-pitsaboana manan-kery dia mitondra anao mivantana any amin'ny antsipiriany.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Omeo fahazoan-dàlana amin'ny fakantsary ao amin'ny fikirakirana ny navigateur, na ampidiro tanana ny rohy fanasana.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Tsy hita ny fakantsary. Ampidiro ny rohy fanasana nalefan'ny hopitaly.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Tsy misy ny fakantsary amin'izao fotoana izao. Ampidiro tanana ny rohy fanasana.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Offline? Mampiseho ny script tafatafa voatahiry
